turns.text: I live in a pretty big city, Manchester, uh, which is up in the north of England.
turns.zh: 我住在一个挺大的城市，曼彻斯特，嗯，在英格兰北部。

turns.text: There's an awful lot of traffic and traffic jams, uh, especially in the rush hour.
turns.zh: 交通特别多，老是堵车，嗯，尤其是高峰期。

turns.text: For me, it's far too noisy.
Um, I think I prefer to live in the countryside.
turns.zh: 嗯，我觉得我更愿意住在乡下。

turns.text: Okay, so, what made this second answer even better?
turns.zh: 好，那么，是什么让第二个回答更好呢？

turns.text: Again, first of all, notice the adverbs and adjectives, right?
turns.zh: 再说一次，首先，注意副词和形容词，对吧？

turns.text: I said, "I live in a pretty big."
turns.zh: 我说了，“我住在一个挺大的……”

turns.text: It just gives it a richer sense, right?
turns.zh: 这就让它更有感觉了，对吧？
